replaced_by_deviceside.title: Hue Smooth Dimming is being replaced by DeviceSide
replaced_by_deviceside.description:
Hue Smooth Dimming is no longer being developed. Its successor, DeviceSide, has drop-in replacements for its actions, and adds support for Zigbee2MQTT, ZHA, Shelly, Matter and Control4. [Install DeviceSide from Marketplace]({install_url}), then in your automations and scripts, change:

- `hue_dimmer.raise` to `deviceside.raise_brightness`
- `hue_dimmer.lower` to `deviceside.lower_brightness`
- every other `hue_dimmer.` to `deviceside.`

The fields and responses are the same. Both can run side by side while you switch, and Ignore hides this notice for good. Once no automation or script calls `hue_dimmer.`, remove the Hue Smooth Dimming integration.
